subject: general
question:
Observe the graph and answer the question below.

The graph represents the number of male and female workers in four different companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa884cfbe136a0344aa89ed4141769a4c38df117f60364e3b3b3f9a8ca21a9b7.png] 

 

Which company has the maximum difference in the number of male and female employees?
solution:
**Calculations:**

Male members of A, B, C and D are respectively

Members of A ⇒ Female = 150 & Males = 250

Members of B ⇒ Female = 250 & Male = 350

Members of C ⇒ Female = 150 & Male = 200

Members of D ⇒ Female = 100 & Male = 350

Difference of female & male members

⇒ Difference in A = 250 - 150 = 100

⇒ Difference in B = 350 - 250 = 100

⇒ Difference in C = 200 - 150 = 50

⇒ Difference in D = 350 - 100 = 250

**∴ The correct choice will be option 4.**
